newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMANS BEST IN EUROPE AFTER DORTMUND TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMANS BEST IN EUROPE AFTER DORTMUND TRIUMPH.

text.p: Germany could claim to be the most powerful soccer nation in Europe on Thursday after Borussia Dortmund's European Cup success.
The country has been so successful that a remarkable eight clubs will play in the three European club competitions next season.
After Germany's Euro 96 triumph and Schalke's UEFA Cup victory last week, Dortmund's first Champions' Cup triumph put the country's game at its highest point for decades.
The first words of praise came from defeated Juventus coach Marcello Lippi who is used to Italian sides collecting the spoils from the three European competitions.
"It could not be better for German football with the UEFA and Champions' Cups and the European championship as well," he said.
The last time the Germans enjoyed such a spread of success was during the playing days of Franz Beckenbauer and Gerd Muller in the 1970s.
After the former West Germany won the World Cup in 1974, Bayern Munich won the European Cup three years in succession from 1974.
In 1975, Borussia Moenchengladbach also clinched the UEFA Cup.
